name: drive
title: Drive
description: Standalone and embeddable file browser for any host entity.

files.content:

  spaces: "Drive spaces",
  searchSpaces: "Search spaces",
  searchFiles: "Search this folder",
  emptySpaces: "No spaces found.",
  empty: "This folder is empty.",
  noMatches: "No matching files or folders.",
  loading: "Loading…",
  error: "The operation failed. Please try again.",
  retry: "Retry",
  back: "Back to Drive",
  root: "All files",
  breadcrumbs: "Folder navigation",
  name: "Name",
  size: "Size",
  modified: "Modified",
  actions: "Actions",
  folder: "Folder",
  upload: "Upload files",
  newFolder: "New folder",
  rename: "Rename",
  delete: "Delete",
  download: "Download",
  cancel: "Cancel",
  close: "Close",

  create: "Create",
  next: "Next page",
  first: "First page",
  readOnly: "Read only",
  drop: "Drop files here or choose Upload files.",
  pending: "Please wait…",
  saved: "Changes saved.",
  deleted: "Deletion completed.",
